About OpenAlt

OpenAlt, by Catta Studios: your phone or tablet as another PC screen.

Based on Moonlight for Android (moonlight-stream.org), by Cameron Gutman and contributors, and made for Sunshine (LizardByte). Free software under the GPL-3.0 license.

QR reader: ZXing and zxing-android-embedded (Apache-2.0).
